blocks.content: Here's a step-by-step breakdown of the function calls and the printed values:
The printNumbers() function calls itself until n equals 3.
When n equals 3, the base case is reached and the function execution ends with the return statement — terminating the recursive calls.
Here, the printNumbers() function doesn't return any value. Next, we will learn to return values from recursive functions.
